title: Predicting Detection Filters for Small Footprint Open-vocabulary Keyword Spotting

novelty_points.claim: 提出开放词汇关键词检测方法，由辅助网络预测关键词检测层的参数，为新增关键词生成检测器而不要求任务专用训练数据。
novelty_points.claim_en: Proposes open-vocabulary keyword spotting where an auxiliary network predicts keyword detection layer parameters to generate detectors for new keywords without task-specific training data.
technical_features: 辅助网络预测执行关键词检测的最上层参数。
根据发音词典或字素到音素转换器得到关键词音素序列。
关键词编码器计算卷积核，用生成的卷积核建立顶层检测层。
technical_features_en: An auxiliary network predicts the topmost layer that performs keyword detection.
Obtains keyword phone sequences from a pronunciation lexicon or a grapheme-to-phoneme converter.
A keyword encoder computes convolution kernels used to build the top detection layer.

novelty_points.claim: 在保留开放词汇关键词检测能力的同时，使用已有关键词的专用数据微调检测模型。
novelty_points.claim_en: Fine-tunes the keyword spotting model with data for specific keywords while retaining its ability to handle new keywords.
technical_features: 当部分关键词具备专用训练数据时对模型进行微调。
微调后保留模型应用于新关键词的能力。
technical_features_en: Fine-tunes the model when specific training data is available for some keywords.
Retains the ability to apply the model to new keywords after fine-tuning.
